createdAs.status: PROVEN for the captured types; other types use the default (UNVERIFIED). The configure call that follows replaces it. In the account, steps still flagged configStep true exist only in flow 309188, which has never been switched on

configuredAs.status: PROVEN for the captured types; STORED for /change-field, /entered-segment, /event and /remove-tag (every configured step of those types in the account's six flows, read by the Flow Reader 2026-09-23 14:06 Paris); other types use the default (UNVERIFIED)
configuredAs.waitCensus: 2026-09-25, Flow Reader 17:49 Paris: 15 Wait steps in the account. 12 store mustConfig {configStep:false} with only time.hour.type among the time settings (capture 1's shape, the builder's); 3 store {configStep:false, mapInputFields:false} with time.enabled false, hour 09:00-17:00 and useAccountTimezone false, as Joe's hand-made A13 Wait did (why the app writes one shape or the other is not known; UNVERIFIED: opening the Wait's time panel). Both shapes are in the live, working flow 310308. The builder keeps the first.

/send.userCanReceiveMoreThanOnce: true when the flow re-enters; otherwise not set

/end-flow-v2.flowIds: {{encharge.flowId}} for this flow, or another flow's id as a string

defaultsOnCreate.note: Encharge fills these when the step is created; a value the spec sets replaces the default. The weekday values only apply when time.enabled is true.

links.note: A link out of a Send email step always carries a Proceed-on condition; the app asks for one. Encharge adds eventListenerIds to such a link when the flow is switched on, not when the link is saved, and keeps them after it is switched off; a link made while the flow is off has none (PROVEN 2026-09-26: Encharge flow ZZ R1 Bounce, 405472, built by the builder, had none until Joe switched it on, then 653140 and 653141, kept when he switched it off; 404885's two email links, made in the app while it was off, have none). Whether a link made while a flow is off, after it has been on, gets one at the next switch-on is UNVERIFIED. The On bounced link is its own link, carrying only that condition: gap A13, closed 2026-09-25 (Joe drew one by hand in flow 404885; link 1373730, Send email 1718202 to a Wait, read by the Flow Reader at 16:49 Paris).

field.value: <value; days for the periods; a number for is more than; text on a Text field, numbers included ("1"); for is empty and is not empty the value Encharge stored in the same place ("" or 0; it seems to carry nothing; api-map 6.1)>

buildTabNumberMenu.source: Joe's screenshot of the Check condition menu for Login Count (a Number field), 2026-09-23

stored.more than: is more than: PROVEN (evidence/reader-2026-09-23.json; the value is stored as a number)
stored.is / is not: the same words: PROVEN on Text and True/False fields; not yet seen on a Number field
stored.is empty / is not empty: not yet seen on a Number field (gap A7c). On custom Text fields both are PROVEN (is empty only in a check); on custom Date fields is empty is PROVEN; the rest is gap A11 (evidence/reader-2026-09-23-a10.json)
stored.less than: not yet seen; Encharge's own Event filter schema lists "is less than"
stored.at least: not yet seen; the Event filter schema lists "at least"
stored.is any: not yet seen; the Event filter schema lists "is any", with no value
stored.is any of / is not any of: not yet seen, and in no captured schema

unverified: number: less than, at least, is any, is any of, is not any of; is, is not, is empty and is not empty on a Number field (gap A7c)
a segment row inside a Check condition step (gap A9; seen only in segments)

the empty tests not yet seen stored: is empty on a Text field in a segment, is not empty on a Date field, and either test on a field no user created (built-in, system, read-only or integration fields) (gap A11; none needed by v47 as far as known)

whether a row is "1" on a Text field finds contacts whose value a writer stored as the number 1 (gap A12; needed by v47's Abandoners edit; live test B3 counts it for segments; checks need a run with a test contact)

proven.date is empty: evidence/reader-2026-09-23-a10.json: stored as "is empty" with 0, in the check and the segment; ZZ Capture Segment still loads with it (251 people, Joe, 2026-09-24)
proven.text is not empty: evidence/reader-2026-09-23-a10.json: stored as "is not empty" with 0 in the check and "" in ZZ Capture Segment (two older segments hold 0 and no value)
proven.a number typed on a Text field: evidence/reader-2026-09-23-a10.json: stored as text, "1", in the check and the segment. Flow 310308's checks hold the numbers 1 and 2; how they came to be numbers is not known

provenOnFieldType.source: evidence/reader-2026-09-23-a10.json, conditionCensus: every condition row stored in the account (42 rows, read 2026-09-23 15:38 Paris)
provenOnFieldType.note: Values for is empty and is not empty on custom fields, as stored: Text is empty "" (a check only); Date is empty 0 (check and segment); Text is not empty 0 (a check, and segment Abandoners (historic)), "" (ZZ Capture Segment) and no value (segment Subscribers, on the built-in field email). The compiler writes the value stored for the same test, field type and place (compile.py EMPTY_VALUE), only on fields a user created (createdBy "user"), as every stored one is; everything else is gap A11
